subject.title: [Feature]: Discord thread-reply mention gate — respond to thread starter freely, require mention for follow-up replies

question: Should Discord get an opt-in autoThread follow-up mention gate, and what public config shape should own it?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds public Discord config surface and changes which thread replies reach the agent, so automation should not choose the permanent API or default semantics.

options.title: Add default-off explicit thread gate
options.body: Introduce an opt-in Discord thread policy that requires explicit mentions for follow-up replies while preserving current autoThread behavior for existing users.

options.title: Fold into parent/thread override
options.body: Make the broader Discord parent-versus-thread requireMention design cover this behavior and explicitly decide bot-owned autoThread precedence there.

options.title: Keep current continuation
options.body: Decline new config surface and document that bot-owned autoThreads intentionally continue without mentions.

recommendation.title: Add default-off explicit thread gate
recommendation.body: Introduce an opt-in Discord thread policy that requires explicit mentions for follow-up replies while preserving current autoThread behavior for existing users.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across shared mention gating and Discord preflight routing, and this decision crosses channel policy plus config compatibility.
